summary: Virtual analogue oscillator: tuned_phasor → phase_dist (d-only, PWM) → naive_osc. `shape` (0 = band-limited saw, 1 = sine, 2 = triangle, 3 = band-limited pulse, 4 = white noise), `octave` (−3..3), `semi` (−11..11), `cent` (−100..100) tune the pitch (note-derived), `width` is the phase_dist bend `d`, 16384 (default) = no bend, anything else phase-distorts the tonal shapes (classic PWM on the pulse, a bent timbre on saw/sine/triangle), `width_mod` wires a control source into the bend. Saw and pulse are band-limited (six levels via `mip`), noise ignores pitch.
